title: Mystic Seed Crystal
description: A glowing crystal ball rests on an ornate dark blue and gold pedestal inscribed with 'SLOT-12 - SEED 91233'. Inside the transparent sphere, vibrant pink, yellow, and green flowers and stems radiate from a bright pink core. Ethereal green smoke and floating petals swirl around the orb while a luminous moon casts a green beam of light from the upper right.
prompt: A glowing magical crystal ball on an ornate dark blue pedestal with gold accents, inscribed SLOT-12 SEED 91233. Inside the sphere, colorful flowers in pink, yellow, and green radiate from a bright pink glowing core like a dandelion burst. Green mystical smoke and floating petals surround the orb. A luminous moon in a dark sky casts a green beam of light onto the crystal, surreal fantasy digital painting, atmospheric and ethereal.
